auth.failed: Sign-in failed. Check your email and password.

access.title: You do not have access to the admin console
access.description: Your account exists, but it does not carry an administrator permission. If you believe this is a mistake, contact your system administrator.

search.title: Search the console
search.description: Search employees, content, districts, and media

section.readyTitle: This screen is ready to connect
section.readyDescription: Navigation and permissions are live. The full management UI for this module will land once its Phase API is complete.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: An organizational snapshot — every number comes from real data.
dashboard.communityActivityHint: Comments per day — a real signal from the platform
dashboard.recentActivityHint: From the audit log — fills as administrators publish
dashboard.activityEmpty: No audit entries yet. Administrative actions will appear here.

content.title: Content
content.subtitle: Announcements, posts, and messages that appear in the employee app
content.emptyDescription: Try changing the filters, or create a new content item.
content.published: Published — it will appear in the employee app
content.confirmArchiveDescription: {count} items will be archived. You can restore them later.
content.confirmArchiveOne: This item will be archived and will no longer appear in the app.

form.summaryHint: One line shown on the Home card. Empty = the title.
form.imageHint: Upload a file or paste an address. The card image is decorative; the text carries the meaning.
form.audienceHint: Nothing ticked = everyone in the Ministry. Several ticks in one group = any of them; different groups = all together.
form.publishAtHint: Empty = now. A future date schedules it.
form.districtHint: The district shown on the card. It does not limit who sees it.

appearsIn.ANNOUNCEMENT: Appears in the "Announcements" section on Home. Pinned items show first.
appearsIn.FEED_POST: Appears in the community feed, in the channel you choose.
appearsIn.EVENT: Appears in the "Events" section on Home until it starts, and employees can register.
appearsIn.CAREER: Appears on the job board and in the "Careers" section on Home until it closes.
appearsIn.TRAINING: Appears in the "Trainings" section on Home until it starts, and employees can register.
appearsIn.CEO_MESSAGE: The latest published message shows in the "CEO message" section on Home.
appearsIn.VIDEO: A video marked "video of the week" shows in that section on Home.
appearsIn.ALERT: Shows at the top of Home, above everything else, until it expires.

homeLayout.title: Home screen sections
homeLayout.subtitle: Reorder, hide, retitle, set how many items, and choose who sees each section. A section with nothing in it is not shown at all.

employees.title: Employees
employees.subtitle: The Ministry directory — filtered to what you may manage.
employees.search: Search by name, email, or title…
employees.emptyDescription: Try changing the filters or the search term.
employees.rolesRequired: At least one role is required
employees.rolesHint: Roles decide permissions — {count} right now. Only an admin can grant "System admin".
employees.activeHint: Deactivating signs the employee out at once and blocks sign-in. It can be undone.
employees.confirmDeactivate: {name} will be signed out and cannot sign in until the account is reactivated.

districts.title: Districts
districts.subtitle: The Ministry's five districts, with live figures.

audit.title: Audit Logs
audit.subtitle: Every administrative action — who, what, and when. Read-only.
audit.emptyDescription: Administrative actions will appear here as they happen.

quests.title: Department goals
quests.subtitle: Each department's monthly goal in My World ({month}), and what it gets for reaching it.
quests.reward: What the department gets for reaching the goal
quests.rewardPlaceholder: e.g. a team breakfast on Thursday
quests.rewardHint: Employees see this on the department card in My World. No money, no ranking.
quests.emptyDescription: You can set a reward for the department you belong to. You aren't assigned to one right now.

worldMetrics.title: My World: is it working?
worldMetrics.subtitle: Totals only. Nothing here is broken down by person.
worldMetrics.headline: Headline figures
worldMetrics.visitorsHint: At least one visit in range.
worldMetrics.returnHint: {returned} of {base} whose first visit in range was a week or more ago.
worldMetrics.missionHint: {completed} of {opens} mission opens ended in the act itself within a week.
worldMetrics.attendanceHint: {attended} attended, {missed} didn't, {unanswered} didn't answer, of {total} registrations for sessions that took place.
worldMetrics.focusHint: Acts per active employee in range.
worldMetrics.focusNote: Focus is the current choice. This is a correlation, not proof of cause.
worldMetrics.actsHint: Every counted act in range, Ministry-wide.
worldMetrics.recognitionHint: Thank-yous employees gave, by week (last 8 weeks).
worldMetrics.privacy: These figures come from the same rows that power My World. No per-person breakdown, no ranking.

media.title: Media library
media.subtitle: Upload files to storage and get an address to use in content.
media.uploadHint: Images, documents, presentations. Editors can also upload images straight from the form.
media.copyFailed: Copy failed — select and copy by hand

homeScreen.title: Home screen
homeScreen.subtitle: What employees see when they open the app. Changes reach them within half a minute.
homeScreen.noAccessTitle: You cannot manage the Home screen

metrics.title: Key numbers
metrics.subtitle: The figures in the "Key numbers" section, in this order.
metrics.label: Label

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: The projects in the "Projects" section. Each employee sees their own district's first.
projects.name: Project name

weekly.title: Weekly summary
weekly.subtitle: The latest week's summary shows in the "Weekly summary" section on Home.
weekly.dialogHint: One summary per week. The latest week is the one shown.
weekly.weekOfHint: The Sunday the week starts on.

subtitle.EVENT: Events, registrations, and who actually came. Edit an event in the content editor.
subtitle.TRAINING: Trainings, seats left, and who actually came. Edit a training in the content editor.

sessions.emptyDescription: Try another time range, or create one.

careers.title: Careers
careers.subtitle: Positions and tenders on the job board and on Home.

servicesAdmin.title: Services
servicesAdmin.subtitle: The employees' Services screen: quick actions and links to systems. The order here is the order in the app.

actions.title: Quick actions
actions.subtitle: Tasks employees start with a tap — a report, a request, a form.
actions.hint: An in-app path (starting with /) or a full address.

links.title: Links to systems
links.subtitle: Systems employees leave the app for — payroll, attendance, IT.

servicesAdmin.label: Name
servicesAdmin.hrefHint: https://… or a path starting with /

community.title: Community
community.subtitle: Moderate the conversation: comments, thank-yous between colleagues, and channels.
community.commentsHint: The latest comments across all posts. A removal is logged in the audit log with the text and the reason.
community.recognitionsHint: Thank-yous employees gave each other. A removal is logged in the audit log with the text and the reason.
community.removeHint: It disappears from the app. The text and the reason are kept in the audit log.

permissionsAdmin.title: Permissions
permissionsAdmin.subtitle: What each role can do. Roles are granted per employee on the Employees screen.
permissionsAdmin.matrixHint: The same table the API enforces — what it says here is what actually happens.

roleHints.MANAGER: Publishes within their scope and sets their department's goal reward.
roleHints.DISTRICT_MANAGER: Manages their district's content and approves it.
roleHints.CONTENT_EDITOR: Manages all content, the Home screen, and Services.

permissions.content_manage: Manage all content and the community
permissions.feeds_manage: Manage the Home screen and Services
permissions.analytics_view: View analytics and the audit log
